correctness.rationale: Independently reconstructed parent-choice PGF recurrences for ρ_n, µ_n and A_n=Cov(D_n,B_n(z)), including conditional root-selection covariance. Coefficient extraction gives exact unary formula [n/4−(3/2)H_{n−2}−1/(2(n−1))]/(n−1). An independent parent-array enumeration verified finite cases through n=7, and exact rational boundary values are negative at 21 and positive at 22; F(n+1)−F(n)=(n²−7n+2)/(4n(n−1))>0 for n≥7 proves uniqueness. For fixed k, root PGF implies P(D_n=k)→0, µ_k/n→2^{-k-1}, and the Cesàro recurrence proves the covariance limit. No uniformity in k; finite-sum conservation makes the nonuniformity necessary.
